1.7.2+261031 (2026-11-16)

MTX guide links open the current documentation (#68)

The documentation link and the OpenTAK ICU, GoPro and UAS Tool guide links in the MTX view now open docs.opendefence.fi in the user's language, instead of the old docs.pvarki.fi site that is no longer updated. The English UAS Tool link no longer leads to a removed page.

Changelog

Fixes

  • point the MTX guide links to docs.opendefence.fi (e50c303)

Other changes

  • update uv.lock for the version bump (dc9031a)
